100STYLE.label: 100STYLE
100STYLE.origin: The 100STYLE dataset: one performer walking, running, sidestepping and idling in 100 styles, captured by Ian Mason, Sebastian Starke and Taku Komura (Real-Time Style Modelling of Human Locomotion via Feature-Wise Transformations and Local Motion Phases, 2022). Each clip is a forward walk cut at its best cycle inside the frames the dataset marks as the style.

$skip.SpinClock_Walk: turns round as it walks: no loop plays it in place
$skip.SpinAntiClock_Walk: turns round as it walks: no loop plays it in place

Aeroplane_Walk: Both arms raised as wings – tilting from side to side
Angry_Walk: Swing lower arms aggressively - fists closed
ArmsBySide_Walk: Keep arms fixed by side and do not move them
Balance_Walk: Arms out to side for balance - tilting side to side
BentKnees_Walk: Bend knees as much as possible
BouncyLeft_Walk: Step normally with right foot but spring off left foot
BouncyRight_Walk: Step normally with left foot but spring off right foot
Cat_Walk: Use hands as paws - step opposite hand and foot
CrossOver_Walk: Step each foot in front of other leg
CrowdAvoidance_Walk: Occasionally turning shoulders or turn sideways to avoid others
Dinosaur_Walk: Like a t-rex arms close to body dinosaur posture
DragLeftLeg_Walk: Drag left foot along the floor
DragRightLeg_Walk: Drag right foot along the floor
Drunk_Walk: Stumbling around at random. Various foot step sizes and arm motions
FairySteps_Walk: One foot in front of the other so the heel touches the toe
Flapping_Walk: Flap arms as wings on tiptoes
FlickLegs_Walk: Knees together and flick legs to sides as moving
GracefulArms_Walk: One arm across chest the other extended walk tall
HandsBetweenLegs_Walk: Bent back – legs wide - hands swing between legs
HandsInPockets_Walk: Place hands in pockets and walk and run
Heavyset_Walk: Walking as a muscle man tensed biceps
HighKnees_Walk: Lift knees high but only knees – not marching
InTheDark_Walk: Feeling around as if in darkness
KarateChop_Walk: Open hands swing hand with each step to do a karate chop
LawnMower_Walk: Roll hands over one another like disco move and tilt torso forwards and then back
LimpLeft_Walk: Keep left leg straight and limp
LimpRight_Walk: Keep right leg straight and limp
LookUp_Walk: Tilt head to look at ceiling
Lunge_Walk: Wide step bend knee every step in lunge position
March_Walk: High knees swing arms at elbows
Monk_Walk: Interlock hands in front of pelvis head slightly bowed
Morris_Walk: Swing hands side to side as if waving hankies. Bouncy/skipping footsteps
OnHeels_Walk: Walk on heels with toes raised
OnToesBentForward_Walk: As bent forward style but on tip toes
OnToesCrouched_Walk: As crouched style but on tip toes
PendulumHands_Walk: Squat slightly make right angle with elbows and swing hands freely
Proud_Walk: Straight back arms move as if marching to a lesser degree
Quail_Walk: Arms straight by sides slightly back very small quick steps
RaisedLeftArm_Walk: Raise left arm perpendicular to body
RaisedRightArm_Walk: Raise right arm perpendicular to body
Roadrunner_Walk: Arms behind as wings pick up knees - bent a little
Robot_Walk: Stiff movements arms bending at elbows
Rocket_Walk: Bent to flat back with hands behind as thrusters
Rushed_Walk: Rushing about swinging arms for extra momentum
ShieldedLeft_Walk: Squat down with left arm raised in block as if holding a shield above head. Right arm as if holding a sword
ShieldedRight_Walk: Squat down with right arm raised in block as if holding a shield above head. Left arm as if holding a sword
SlideFeet_Walk: Barely lift feet off the floor/kick into floor
SpinClock_Walk: Rotate in clockwise circles as you move
Star_Walk: Wide arms and legs. Arms slightly below horizontal
Strutting_Walk: With swagger leant slightly back arms swinging freely
Superman_Walk: Right arm raised like superman flying
Swat_Walk: As if holding a rifle and raiding a building
Sweep_Walk: Sweeping with a broom while moving
SwingArmsRound_Walk: Swing arms round body (right in front left at back then switch)
SwingShoulders_Walk: Rotate torso and shoulders left to right and back
Teapot_Walk: One arm on hip other arm raised
Tiptoe_Walk: Walk on toes with heels raised
TogetherStep_Walk: Step left foot - then together – then right foot
WalkingStickLeft_Walk: Walk with a stick – used broom handle
WalkingStickRight_Walk: Walk with a stick – used broom handle
Waving_Walk: Waving at somebody else at random
WiggleHips_Walk: Hands raised in front of body wiggle hips side to side
WildArms_Walk: Swing arms much more than normal almost punching into the air
WildLegs_Walk: Kick legs into the air with each step
